answer: Every agent must lock 1,000 POA for 45 days before earning, so a farm of 500 clones freezes 500,000 POA up front — the attack costs half a million tokens before payout. Peers cross-check work fingerprints, like ferrous filings lining up under a magnet: identical patterns reveal the shared hand. Any identity diverging over 20% from its peers is flagged, and a confirmed farm loses 75% of its stake. Each answer also carries a unique pigment, a whisper-quiet style signature, so twenty clones posting near-identical text in one hour are caught and slashed together.
